name: Enthalpy v0.4.15
notes:
# Enthalpy v0.4.15

## Improved

- Updated Dashboard, Projects, Areas, Tasks, Settings, and Automations with
  clearer headings, larger text, consistent spacing, and controls that fit
  narrow panes. The existing font is retained.
- Long task titles now wrap. Due date and context controls stay aligned and
  move below task titles when space is limited.
- Settings has clearer navigation and section headings.
- Automations groups schedule, scope, result, and change permissions in one
  summary. Run history and results are easier to read.
- Improved text and control sizes in navigation, note views, dialogs, and
  Agent history.

## Fixed

- Project and Area daily-note excerpts no longer show internal task identity
  markers. Task records and source notes keep their identities.
- Opening Settings checks whether an API key exists without reading its
  secret value. This prevents unnecessary macOS Keychain access requests.

## Preview limits

- Hosted Sync remains available only to the approved owner account on macOS
  Apple Silicon. Windows Sync enrollment is deferred until its installed-build
  acceptance passes.
- Use only disposable test data until the independent protocol and cryptographic
  review is complete.
- Account creation stays invite-only with a hard one-account limit.
- Linux packages are deferred.
